title: Aider
description: Configure model endpoints. Store only secret names here.

fields.label: Plain Aider (no automatic replies)
fields.description: Explicitly bypass the pinned Domios adapter. Chat still works; automatic replies to other tabs are unavailable.

fields.label: Endpoints
fields.description: Each model ID must belong to exactly one endpoint. Supported kinds: openai, anthropic, groq, openrouter.

fields.label: Models and tuning
fields.description: One model ID per line, or a JSON array of strings/objects. Objects: id, displayName (optional), mapTokens (nonnegative integer; 8192 suggested for large context; omit for Aider default), reasoningMode (effort or budget), reasoningEfforts ([{id, displayName, thinkingTokens for budget}]), defaultReasoningEffort (optional declared id). No reasoning flag is sent without a chosen declared level.
